title: ADR: Embeddable GCS SDK and Modular Native Build
summary: Decides that GeniusCognitiveSystem becomes the stable embeddable SDK and C ABI boundary with backend-neutral Flutter chat contracts and per-module CMake ownership, with GNUS-NEO-SWARM injected behind RuntimeCoordinator.
scope: stable C ABI for Flutter and FFI consumers
Flutter chat UI packages (gcs_client, gcs_chat, gcs_native)
native targets (gcs_common, gcs_runtime, gcs_chat_core, gcs_api, gcs_ffi, neoswarm_runtime)
heavy dependency isolation (MNN, Vulkan/MoltenVK, SGProcessingManager, SuperGenius, libp2p, RocksDB)
PImpl and abstract interfaces for ABI stability
